title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album’ Will Feature 34 New Tracks — Hear the First Six Songs From the Project
summary: Featuring a mega-watt group of artists, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album will arrive Nov. 19, the same day as the game's release. The album's first six songs are streaming now.
contentText:
Ahead of the hugely anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI , Atlantic Records and Rockstar Games have today (Sept. 17) announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.

The album will feature 34 new songs, with the complete project dropping Nov. 19, the same day as the game’s release.

Ahead of that drop, six of the album’s songs are streaming now. These songs include a mega-watt array of genre-spanning artists, with Yung Lean ft. Future and Metro Boomin contributing a song titled “That’s It,” a song called “RHYNO” performed by Travis Scott and produced by Daft Punk’s Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo and CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Étienne de Crécy together contributing a song called “Sexy Magic.” The final three newly released songs are “The Last Thing You Need” by Morgan Wallen, “Macacoa 2000” by Rauw Alejandro and “Bright Lights, Big City” by Keith Richards.

Songs from the album are designed to capture the energy of Vice City and Leonida, the fictional world the game is set inside of. This music is intended to continue the Grand Theft Auto series’ penchant for introducing new music and musical subcultures to a global audience.

Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album will arrive alongside the next iteration of the game’s in-game radio stations, score, and other musical touchpoints that define the series. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is available for pre-order now and will launch with multiple vinyl and CD offerings, including three Atlantic Records exclusives: a limited-edition liquid-filled vinyl, a splatter edition vinyl, and a CD jewel case – each featuring exclusive new artwork and packaging designs that echo the signature style of Grand Theft Auto VI .

There will also be various retail exclusives for Blood Records, Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Target, Urban Outfitters, and Indie record stores, each coming with a unique vinyl pressing design and poster.
